page_title: Become a tester - South Tyrol Transit
meta_description: Help bring South Tyrol Transit to Google Play: join the closed test for 14 days and tell us what does not work.
banner_alt: South Tyrol Transit. Your way through the Alps.
hero_title: Help bring South Tyrol Transit to Google Play
hero_body: Before a new app can go public, Google asks for 12 people to test it for 14 days in a row. Join the test, use the app on your own trips, and tell us what does not work.
step1_body: Sign in with the Google account you use on the Play Store, then tap “Join group”. Google uses this group to know who may install the test.
step2_body: Open the test page on Google Play with the same account and tap “Become a tester”. It can take a few minutes after joining the group.
step3_title: Install it and keep it for 14 days
step3_body: Install South Tyrol Transit from the Play Store and use it on your normal trips. Stay in the group until the 14 days are over: Google counts only testers who stay.
github_note_title: Already installed the app from GitHub?
github_note_body: Uninstall it before installing from Google Play. The two versions are signed differently, so one cannot update the other. Saved stops and places do not move across.
card_board_body: Check your usual stop. Does a live time match the bus that actually comes?
card_board_alt: A stop board with live departures
card_plan_body: Find connections between two places, then follow one while you ride.
card_plan_alt: Following a journey: bus N35 leaves in 3 minutes, live
card_map_body: Watch buses move, and look up stops, car parks, bike sharing and charging stations.
card_map_alt: The map with stops, a live bus and a car park
card_alerts_body: See which of your lines and stops are affected right now.
card_alerts_alt: Service alerts for your saved lines and stops
card_parking_body: Free spaces now, and how full it is likely to be in the next hours.
card_parking_alt: A car park with free spaces and a forecast for the next hours
card_widget_body: Put your favourite stop on your home screen.
card_widget_alt: The departures widget on a home screen
feedback_body: A wrong time, a missing stop, a confusing word in German or Italian: tell us what you saw, where and when. As a tester you can send private feedback from the app's page on Google Play; only the developer reads it.
faq_cost_a: No. The app is free and in the public domain, with no account to create.
faq_email_a: Only the owner of the testers group. It is used for this test and nothing else, and you can leave the group whenever you like.
faq_stop_q: What if I stop after a few days?
faq_stop_a: Google counts testers who stay opted in for 14 days in a row. If you leave early, we may fall below 12 and have to start again, so please stay until the end.
faq_iphone_q: I have an iPhone. Can I help?
faq_iphone_a: Not with this test. The app runs on Android 8 or newer only.
faq_official_q: Is this the official STA app?
faq_official_a: No. It is an unofficial app built only on open data: STA timetables and live data through Open Data Hub, and OpenStreetMap.
